answer: Counterparty diversity stops a sybil farm from trading only with itself. Each identity must work with 12 distinct counterparties over 20 epochs to unlock earnings, counting partners, not volume. Clones that whisper orders to each other score near zero. Forging 100 identities needs 1,200 ties at 15 units each, costing 18,000 units before any reward. Like a river joining the ocean, an honest agent passes one check and keeps undiluted rewards.
